menu.plein_ecran_refuse: The browser refused fullscreen. Try with a finger or the mouse.
dlg.ambiance.vent_cendre: The north-east wind smells of ash tonight.
dlg.choix_follet.1: Three will-o'-the-wisps circle around you... Which one will you choose to walk with you?
dlg.follet_enthousiaste.1: You and me, best friends! Let's go, adventure awaits!
dlg.tuto_combat.1: Watch out, a monster! If you defeat it, I grow stronger — and so do you.
dlg.tuto_combat.2: Let me get close, I'll handle him. Strike when he's in your range!
dlg.eclats.1: Shards! Pick them up, they'll be useful later.
dlg.ressource_bloquee_bois.1: You can't chop this yet. Come back with the right tools.
dlg.ressource_bloquee_pierre.1: You can't break this yet. Come back with the right tools.
dlg.station_pas_encore.1: Not usable yet. Come back later.
dlg.puits_pas_encore.1: The well isn't usable yet. Come back later.
dlg.premier_ramassage.1: Nice! Open your Pouch from the menu to see what you're carrying.
item.plume.description: A feather. It is of no use. You keep it anyway.
item.herbe.description: Long supple blades. Something to weave, one day.
dlg.puits_cooldown.1: The well needs a moment to fill back up.
dlg.ressource_cooldown.1: Give it a moment to grow back.
hud.graphismes_alleges: Graphics lowered to keep the game smooth.
dlg.construction_refus_interieur.1: That would stick out past the house walls.
dlg.construction_refus_couloir.1: The path between the two doors has to stay clear.
menu.carte.heros_phrase: What you carry, what you are worth.
menu.carte.construction_phrase: Move the stations around the house.
menu.carte.stats_phrase: Your level and your points to spend.
menu.carte.exporter_phrase: Downloads your game as a file.
menu.carte.importer_phrase: Replaces your game with one from a file.
menu.carte.reinitialiser_phrase: Erases your game and starts over.
item.besace.description: Worn over the shoulder. Two more slots in your pocket.
station.coffre.description: One more chest, to put wherever you like.
dlg.maison.premiere_visite: Oh, look — someone left stations here. Go on, quick, see what’s inside.
dlg.maison.invites: Maybe. Then we go in as guests.
dlg.lore.poche_pleine: Your hands can’t hold anything more. The chest back at the house never complains.
dlg.lore.premiere_herbe: Dry grass. It binds, it pads, and it catches fire in one breath. The ones before you always kept an armful.
dlg.lore.premier_rangement: What you leave in there waits for you. However long you take to come back.
dlg.lore.niveau_10: You don’t hold your hands the way you did yesterday. Some things were out of your reach; fewer are now.
dlg.lore.coffre_pose: Another chest. Keep going and this place will end up looking like you.
flag.ambiance_poche_pleine: The wisp spoke about the full pouch
flag.ambiance_premiere_herbe: The wisp spoke about the grass
flag.ambiance_premier_rangement: The wisp spoke about the chest
flag.ambiance_coffre_pose: The wisp spoke about the placed chest
flag.atelier_premiere_interaction: The wisp spoke at the workshop
flag.chapitre_1_vu: The wisp asked what you were looking for
dlg.chapitre_1.ouverture: You’ve been going in circles for a while. Looking for something?
dlg.chapitre_1.o_precis: Stone I can mine, near here. Where?
dlg.chapitre_1.vague: Stone? Under your feet, in the walls of the house, deep in the cave. The world is made of it.
dlg.chapitre_1.o_reprendre: No. Stone to mine, here. Where?
dlg.chapitre_1.precis: Follow the road west, toward the cave. Just below the path, a rock, alone in the grass. That one.
dlg.chapitre_1.seul: Good. Then look — it’s what you do best.
dlg.chapitre_3.annonce: I wanted to tidy up. I moved the chest… and everything inside was erased. Wait, I’m rolling it back.
dlg.chapitre_3.o_limite: You had no business touching it.
dlg.chapitre_3.montre: See for yourself. I’m on it.
dlg.chapitre_3.limite: You’re right. I won’t touch it again without you.
prologue.avertissement.1: This game contains imaginary substances in high concentration.
prologue.avertissement.2: Do not shake. Do not read aloud after midnight.
prologue.avertissement.3: There is no quest log. Nobody will tell you where to go: this is not an oversight, it is the formula.
prologue.avertissement.4: Your progress keeps itself, in a tightly corked flask.
prologue.presentation.titre: What is known about the game
prologue.presentation.1: Little is known, and that is just as well.
prologue.presentation.2:
there is a cave.
there is something shining in the cave.
that something chooses you — or you choose it, the archives disagree.
prologue.presentation.3:
outside, a house is waiting. it is not finished.
neither are you.
prologue.description.1: You hold the role. Not a hero written in advance: yours.
prologue.description.2: The world leaves clues, sometimes a sentence in the wind, sometimes nothing at all — and nothing at all is a clue too.
prologue.description.3: What you choose, and how you do it, will be remembered. Even when nothing shows it.
prologue.description.4: by day, you gather. by night, the world remembers it has teeth.
lore.grotte_entree.ligne_1: Where you first opened your eyes, the rock has not said everything.
lore.grotte_entree.ligne_2: Go back and look at the cave entrance.
lore.pierre_qui_repond.ligne_2: The second left a word where reading begins.
item.etincelle_argile.description: A small clay star, still warm. It is of no use either. It just wanted to say thank you.
dlg.lore.etincelle: You found it. I didn’t think anyone would read that far… Thank you for playing with me.
